def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place large models by projected maximum KVPR, then apply improving relocations."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True):
        size = model.model_size
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best, best_score = None, float("inf")

        for gpu in range(gpu_num):
            if size > free[gpu]:
                continue
            remaining = free[gpu] - size
            projected = (load[gpu] + pressure) / remaining if remaining else float("inf")
            score = max(projected if i == gpu else ratios[i] for i in range(gpu_num))
            if score < best_score:
                best, best_score = gpu, score

        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= size
        load[best] += pressure

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_move = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    # A full destination has infinite KVPR and cannot improve the objective.
                    if src == dst or size >= free[dst]:
                        continue
                    src_ratio = (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)
                    dst_ratio = (load[dst] + pressure) / (free[dst] - size)
                    score = max(
                        src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        best_move = src, dst, model, size, pressure

        if best_move is None:
            break
        src, dst, model, size, pressure = best_move
        placement[src].remove(model)
        placement[dst].append(model)
        free[src] += size
        free[dst] -= size
        load[src] -= pressure
        load[dst] += pressure

    # Relocations can be trapped by memory constraints; accept only swaps that
    # strictly lower the exact global maximum KVPR.
    for _ in range(2):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_swap = None

        for left_gpu in range(gpu_num):
            for right_gpu in range(left_gpu + 1, gpu_num):
                for left in placement[left_gpu]:
                    left_size = left.model_size
                    left_pressure = left.req_rate / left.slo
                    for right in placement[right_gpu]:
                        right_size = right.model_size
                        right_pressure = right.req_rate / right.slo
                        left_free = free[left_gpu] + left_size - right_size
                        right_free = free[right_gpu] + right_size - left_size
                        if left_free <= 0 or right_free <= 0:

                        left_ratio = (
                            load[left_gpu] - left_pressure + right_pressure
                        ) / left_free
                        right_ratio = (
                            load[right_gpu] - right_pressure + left_pressure
                        ) / right_free
                        score = max(
                            left_ratio if i == left_gpu else
                            right_ratio if i == right_gpu else ratios[i]
                            for i in range(gpu_num)
                        )
                        if score < best_score:
                            best_score = score
                            best_swap = (
                                left_gpu, right_gpu, left, right,
                                left_free, right_free,
                                left_pressure, right_pressure,

        placement[left_gpu].remove(left)
        placement[right_gpu].remove(right)
        placement[left_gpu].append(right)
        placement[right_gpu].append(left)
        free[left_gpu], free[right_gpu] = left_free, right_free
        load[left_gpu] += right_pressure - left_pressure
        load[right_gpu] += left_pressure - right_pressure
